why: Intro to Git and GitHub plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-git.json), 'Work on a branch' (passes: the add-waffles branch has one commit that main does not have). The learner committed before switching: '[main 5d6e7f8] Add waffles', then `git switch -c add-waffles`. The commit is on main, and the new branch points at the same commit, so add-waffles has nothing main lacks. Every line the checks look for is on screen, in the wrong order.

step.title: Commit waffles.md on the branch
step.instructions: Make a branch named add-waffles and switch to it with git switch -c add-waffles. Then git add waffles.md and git commit -m "Add waffles". main stays as it was.

targets.caption: Make the branch and move to it
